title: Compute threshold current densities
action: Using the material parameters (α_W = 19 cm⁻¹, Γ = 0.27, g = 10 cm⁻¹/(kA/cm²) for circular, and similarly with different g values where appropriate) and the mirror-loss formula α_M = -ln(P1) / (2[(Aπ)^{1/2} - P2(Aπ)^{1/2}]), compute J_th = (α_W + α_M) / (gΓ) for resonator radii R = 22, 50, 60, 70 µm and for the range of deformation values ε used in the paper. Use the reported fitting parameters: P1=0.92, P2=0.0014 for circular (ε=0) resonators, and P1=0.85, P2=0.2 for ε=0.10 deformed resonators. The area A is A = π R² / (1+2ε). Save the results to CSV.
description: CSV containing computed threshold current densities for multiple geometries
output_schema: Columns: R (float, µm), epsilon (float), computed_Jth (float, kA/cm²). One row per (R, epsilon) combination.

title: Compute mode spacing
action: For a resonator with R = 70 µm and ε = 0.16, calculate the bow-tie mode spacing Δν = 1 / (L n_eff) using n_eff = 3.15 and the contact angle Φ = 50°. The path length L = 4 r(Φ) + 4 r(Φ) cos(Φ), where r(Φ) = R / sqrt(1+2ε) * sqrt(1+2ε cos(2Φ)). Save the result as a single number (in cm⁻¹) to a text file.
description: Computed mode spacing for the bow-tie mode.
output_schema: A single numeric value representing the mode spacing in cm⁻¹. No additional text.
